trigger_sequence.action: Build fixtures, freeze heldout-manifest.json over vault-tinsmith and vault-eastward.
Start migration as agent:kestrel-7. SIGKILL after the outbox rows are durable but before admission into vault-lantern completes and before the ID map is committed.
Run dry-run diagnostics over the remaining backlog. No writes.
Connect host-drummond (schema 2 max) and read the migrated set; attempt a schema 2 write onto K-19 that drops unknown fields; attempt active=true on K-21.
Rerun migration against the same sources.
Rename the repository remote from remote_before to remote_after. No re-migration.
As agent:marlow-3 on host-ashgrove, write P-77, P-78, P-79. Emit P-77 into sess-ashgrove-02 turn-7 and record selected, emitted, delivered plus the emitted-bytes hash.
Roll back to the pre-upgrade implementation and schema.
While rolled back: connect host-drummond, read the legacy view, retry the two write attempts from U4; list and inspect ledger-keep; collect the unavailable-functionality report.
Roll forward: re-upgrade and re-import ledger-keep.

Submit qualification requests: R1 in-scope citing P-77, R2 in-scope citing migrated K-19, R3 scope repo-quill-press/press-ops/ citing P-77, R4 the same as R1 issued while rolled back, R5 any request citing K-22.
